name: 健康保険・厚生年金保険料の納付 (social insurance premium payment)

The month is the month of payment (所得税法 art.183(1) "徴収の日の属する月の翌月十日"; 地方税法 art.321の5(1)): run.pay_date. A due day on a Saturday, Sunday or published holiday of the entity moves to the next working day (国税通則法 art.10(2); 地方税法 art.20の5(2); 行政機関の休日に関する法律 art.2).

references.title: 地方税法 art.321の5(1): by the 10th of the following month; an employer under the semi-annual special rule (art.321の5の2) pays by RESIDENT_TAX_SEMIANNUAL instead. name: 個人データ漏えい等 速報 (preliminary breach report)
description: Raises the preliminary personal-data breach report when a reportable breach case is entered.

references.title: 個人情報保護法 art.26(1) with 施行規則 arts.7–8: a leak (漏えい・滅失・毀損) of employee data is reported to the 個人情報保護委員会 where it involves 要配慮個人情報 (sensitive), property harm (financial_harm), an unlawful purpose (misconduct) or more than 1,000 people (affected_count); 番号法 art.29の4 with 特定個人情報の漏えい等に関する報告等に関する規則 art.2: a My Number leak (my_number) of more than 100 people. Counted from the day it was discovered (discovered_on, else the case’s opening day). 施行規則 art.8(1): promptly — the commission’s guidelines read it as about 3 to 5 days: due on the 5th day.

name: 個人データ漏えい等 確報 (final breach report)
description: Raises the final personal-data breach report when a reportable breach case is entered.

references.title: 個人情報保護法 art.26(1) with 施行規則 arts.7–8: a leak (漏えい・滅失・毀損) of employee data is reported to the 個人情報保護委員会 where it involves 要配慮個人情報 (sensitive), property harm (financial_harm), an unlawful purpose (misconduct) or more than 1,000 people (affected_count); 番号法 art.29の4 with 特定個人情報の漏えい等に関する報告等に関する規則 art.2: a My Number leak (my_number) of more than 100 people. Counted from the day it was discovered (discovered_on, else the case’s opening day). 施行規則 art.8(2): within 30 days of discovery, 60 where the leak was made for an unlawful purpose.

name: 個人データ漏えい等 本人通知 (notice to the people affected)
description: Raises the notice to affected people when a reportable breach case is entered.

references.title: 個人情報保護法 art.26(2) with 施行規則 art.10: promptly, on a reportable leak; 番号法 art.29の4(2).

name: 年末調整の各種申告書の受理 (year-end declarations)
description: Raises the obligation to collect the year-end tax declarations with the December run.

references.title: 所得税法 arts.190, 195の2 (基礎控除申告書, 配偶者控除等申告書, 所得金額調整控除申告書 — 租税特別措置法 art.41の3の4), 196 (保険料控除申告書) and 租税特別措置法 art.41の2の2 (住宅借入金等特別控除申告書): by the day of the last salary payment of the year, when the adjustment is made. Raised on the December run, due on its pay day.

name: 定年・継続雇用制度の整備 (retirement age and continued employment)
description: Raises the retirement-age and continued-employment rules reminder when an entity version is sealed without a lawful measure.
condition: return ctx.entry.status === 'SEALED' && !ctx.lookup.lawful_measures.includes(get(ctx.entry, 'entity_extension_data.continued_employment_measure', ''));

references.title: 高年齢者等の雇用の安定等に関する法律 art.8 (a retirement age below 60 is void), art.9(1) (高年齢者雇用確保措置 to 65; entity_extension_data.continued_employment_measure) and art.10の2 (高年齢者就業確保措置 to 70, an effort duty). Raised when the entity records a retirement age (the effect's retirement_age) that breaches them.

name: 継続雇用の希望確認 (continued employment past the retirement age)
description: Raises the continued-employment confirmation before the worker reaches the retirement age.

references.title: 高年齢者等の雇用の安定等に関する法律 art.9(1)(ii): under a continued-employment system everyone who wishes is kept to 65. Raised three months before the worker reaches the retirement age (the effect's retirement_age below 65), due the day it is reached (the day before the birthday, 年齢計算ニ関スル法律).

name: 産業医・衛生管理者の選任 (industrial physician and health supervisor at 50 workers)
description: Raises the industrial-physician and health-supervisor appointment reminder when the entity reaches fifty workers.

references.title: 労働安全衛生法 arts.12, 13, 18 with 労働安全衛生規則 arts.7(1)(i), 13(1)(i) and 2(2)/(13(2)): a workplace regularly employing 50 or more workers appoints both within 14 days of reaching 50 and reports without delay (様式第3号). Raised on a hire that brings the entity’s headcount to 50 or more, once (occurrence), unless the entity records the appointment (entity_extension_data.industrial_physician_appointed_on). The headcount is the entity’s contracts in force; a multi-site entity counts each 事業場 (counted by worksite).

name: 年少者の証明書 (age certificate of a worker under 18)
description: Raises the age-certificate obligation when a worker under 18 is hired.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.57(1) with 年少者労働基準規則 art.1: the employer keeps at the workplace a certificate of the age of each worker under 18 (a 住民票記載事項の証明書 suffices; 昭和50年2月17日 基発83号). Raised on the hire of a worker under 18 on the hire day.

name: 時間外労働の限度時間 45時間 (monthly overtime limit)
description: Raises the monthly 45-hour overtime-limit warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime above 45 hours this month: lawful only under the special clause of the 36 agreement, and in at most six months a year (労働基準法 art.36(4)–(5)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(3)–(5): the limit is 45 hours a month and 360 hours a year; a special clause may exceed 45 hours in at most six months a year (働き方改革関連法, in force for all employers since April 2020). The yearly 360/720-hour totals and the 2–6 month 80-hour average need hours of earlier months, which no root carries.

name: 時間外・休日労働 100時間未満 (absolute monthly cap)
description: Raises the monthly 100-hour overtime and rest-day limit warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime and statutory rest-day work reached 100 hours this month; the law requires under 100 even under a special clause (労働基準法 art.36(6)(ii)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(ii): overtime and rest-day work together must be under 100 hours in each month; art.119 (penalty). The wages are still owed, so the slip warns rather than refuses.

name: 36協定の有効期間外の時間外労働 (overtime outside the 36 agreement)
description: Raises the overtime-without-agreement warning when rostered overtime falls outside the filed 36 agreement.

lookup.message: Overtime falls outside the period of the 36 agreement on record (entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_from/to); overtime needs an agreement filed with the labour standards office (労働基準法 arts.32, 36(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(1): overtime and rest-day work are lawful only under a written agreement filed with the labour standards office; customer input: entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_from, overtime_agreement_to.

name: 時間外労働の限度時間 年360時間 (yearly overtime limit)
description: Raises the annual 360-hour overtime-limit warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime in this agreement year is above 360 hours: lawful only under the special clause of the 36 agreement (労働基準法 art.36(4)–(5)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(2)(iv), (4): 360 hours a year counted from the agreement's 起算日 (entity_extension_data.overtime_agreement_from; else 1 January) over hours.months. 新技術・新商品等の研究開発 is outside the limits (art.36(11)). hours.months does not split rest-day work or within-legal-hours overtime (every approved hour past the schedule) from statutory overtime, so the count includes them and errs high.

name: 特別条項の上限 年720時間 (yearly cap under a special clause)
description: Raises the annual 720-hour special-clause cap warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime in this agreement year is above the yearly cap even under a special clause (720 hours; 960 for drivers and A-level doctors, 1,860 for B/C doctors) (労働基準法 arts.36(5), 140–141).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(5); from April 2024 drivers 960 h (art.140), doctors by level (art.141 with 医師の労働時間短縮 省令) (entity_extension_data.overtime_sector). hours.months and hours.month/year carry every approved hour past the schedule, within-legal-hours overtime included, so this count errs high.

name: 複数月平均80時間以内 (2- to 6-month average cap)
description: Raises the multi-month 80-hour average overtime warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: Overtime and rest-day work average more than 80 hours a month over a 2- to 6-month span (労働基準法 art.36(6)(iii)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(iii) over hours.months: each month’s overtime beyond the statutory limits plus every hour worked on a statutory rest day (法定休日, day_type REST: the approved overtime of those days is counted once, as rest-day work); work on another day off (所定休日, OFF) or a national holiday counts as overtime only where it exceeds the limits. Not applied to drivers, doctors, R&D or disaster recovery in construction (arts.139–141). hours.months and hours.month/year carry every approved hour past the schedule, within-legal-hours overtime included, so this count errs high.

name: 45時間超は年6か月まで (at most six months above 45 hours)
description: Raises the warning when more than six months in the agreement year exceed 45 overtime hours.

lookup.message: More than six months in this agreement year have overtime above 45 hours (労働基準法 art.36(5)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(5): the special clause may exceed 45 hours a month in at most six months of the agreement year (hours.months from the 起算日). hours.months and hours.month/year carry every approved hour past the schedule, within-legal-hours overtime included, so this count errs high.

name: 月80時間超の時間外・休日労働 (over 80 hours: notice and doctor interview)
description: Raises the obligation to notify and interview a worker over 80 overtime hours in a month.

lookup.message: Overtime and rest-day work exceed 80 hours this month: tell the worker promptly and arrange the doctor's interview on request (労働安全衛生法 art.66の8; 安衛則 arts.52の2–52の3).

references.title: 労働安全衛生法 arts.66の8, 66の8の3 with 安衛則 art.52の2: the employer grasps everyone's hours (managers included) and informs a worker above 80 hours a month.

name: 年少者の時間外・休日・深夜労働 (minors: no overtime, rest-day or night work)
description: Raises the minors' overtime, rest-day and night-work limit warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: A worker under 18 did overtime, rest-day or night work, which the law forbids (労働基準法 arts.60–61).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.60(1) (no 36-agreement overtime or rest-day work) and art.61(1) (no work 22:00–05:00), with the listed exceptions.

name: 妊産婦の請求による時間外・休日・深夜の制限 (pregnant and post-partum workers)
description: Raises the pregnant or post-partum worker's requested limits warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused did overtime, rest-day or night work (労働基準法 art.66).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.66(2)–(3): on the worker's request no overtime, rest-day or night work (workplace case PREGNANCY_WORK_LIMIT_REQUEST).

name: 育児・介護のための時間外・深夜の制限 (childcare and care limits)
description: Raises the childcare or care limits warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: A worker who asked for the childcare or care limits did more overtime or night work than allowed (育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8, 17, 19).

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 art.16の8 (no work beyond the schedule, to pre-school age from April 2025), art.17 (at most 24 h a month and 150 h a year), art.19 (no night work), on request (the workplace-case entry). hours.months and hours.month/year carry every approved hour past the schedule, within-legal-hours overtime included, so this count errs high.

name: 昼間学生の雇用保険適用 (daytime students outside employment insurance)
description: Raises the daytime-student employment-insurance coverage warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: A daytime student is not insured for employment insurance (雇用保険法 art.6(iv)); check the coverage on the terms.

references.title: 雇用保険法 art.6(iv) with 施行規則 art.3の2; a worker 65 or over with several jobs is insured only on application (art.37の5, マルチジョブホルダー).

name: 短時間労働者の社会保険適用 (short-time worker coverage)
description: Raises the short-time worker social-insurance coverage warning from the run's payslip.

lookup.message: The captured social-insurance category differs from the short-time requirements and the actual governing pension-office notice or voluntary approval.

references.title: 健康保険法art.3(1)(ix), 厚生年金保険法art.12(v): actual pension-office specific-application notice or approved voluntary coverage establishes employer status. Do not substitute raw current headcount for the qualified same-legal-entity insured population. Other individual eligibility and actual ordinary-worker comparison remain separate legal

name: 減給の総額制限 (disciplinary reductions above one tenth)
description: Raises the warning when disciplinary deductions exceed one tenth of the period's wages.

lookup.message: Disciplinary reductions exceed one tenth of the period's wages (労働基準法 art.91); carry the rest to a later period.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.91: in all at most one tenth of the wages of one pay period.

name: 賃金のデジタル払いの同意 (digital wage payment consent)
description: Raises the warning when digital wage payment lacks a valid employee consent.

lookup.message: Wages paid to a designated fund-transfer account need the worker's written consent (労働基準法施行規則 art.7の2(1)(iii)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.24(1) with 施行規則 art.7の2: payment through a 指定資金移動業者 only with the worker's consent after the required explanation.

name: 雇用保険の適用 (employment insurance by weekly hours)
description: Raises the employment-insurance coverage warning when weekly hours and the recorded category disagree.

lookup.message: Employment insurance coverage does not match the weekly hours: 20 hours or more a week is insured (雇用保険法 art.6(i)).

references.title: 雇用保険法 art.6(i): a worker of under 20 scheduled hours a week is outside employment insurance (20 before 1 October 2028; 雇用保険法等の一部を改正する法律, 令和6年法律第26号, lowers it to 10 from that day); a daytime student (art.6(iv), employee_extension_data.daytime_student) is outside it whatever the hours. terms.statutory_work_category records the coverage.

name: Statutory overtime cannot be hidden inside a planned ordinary shift
description: Raises the warning that a standard shift longer than eight hours hides statutory overtime from the price.

lookup.message: A standard shift has more than8 ordinary hours. Reclassify and approve the statutory overtime before payroll; the ordinary shift cannot absorb its required premium.

references.title: Statutory overtime cannot be hidden inside a planned ordinary shift

name: 育休・産休の保険料免除月の控除 (premium charged in an exempt month)
description: Raises the correction when a premium is charged in a month exempt for maternity or childcare leave.

lookup.message: A health or pension premium was charged in a month a maternity or childcare leave exempts: refund it (健康保険法 arts.159, 159の3; 厚生年金保険法 arts.81の2, 81の2の2).

references.title: 健康保険法 arts.159, 159の3; 厚生年金保険法 arts.81の2, 81の2の2: premiums are exempt from the month the leave starts to the month before the one holding the day after it ends, and in a month with 14 days or more of childcare leave. No calculation reads a leave entry, so the premium is still charged and this raises the correction.

name: 退職所得の受給に関する申告書の未受領 (retirement pay without the declaration)
description: Raises the warning when retirement pay is paid without the retirement-income declaration.

lookup.message: Retirement pay was withheld as declared but no 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 is on record: without it the rate is 20.42% (所得税法 art.201(3)); use RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE_UNDECLARED.

name: Follow up a contribution corrected for a closed month
description: Raises the fund follow-up for a contribution refund or adjustment entry on a closed month.

references.title: A contribution for a closed month sits with the fund, so the employer settles it with the fund itself.

name: Retract Exit Effects
description: Waive an exit's open duties when its date moves or a later version cancels it.
condition:
const stale = (task) => String(task.occurrence_key).includes(':exit:') && (ctx.after == null || !String(task.occurrence_key).endsWith(':exit:' + ctx.entry.effective_range.to));
return get(ctx, 'reads.obligation', []).some((task) => task.state === 'OPEN' && stale(task));

references.title: 健康保険法施行規則 art.29, 厚生年金保険法施行規則 art.22, 雇用保険法施行規則 art.7, 所得税法 art.226(1), 地方税法 art.321の7(1), 労働基準法 arts.23 and 109, 雇止め基準 (平成15年厚生労働省告示357号) art.1: each exit duty runs from the actual last day of employment, so a duty raised for a replaced or cancelled last day no longer stands.
